Class WorldEdits

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.server.WorldEdits
public final class WorldEdits extends Object
Vanilla world-edit mechanics for stack growth and removal: world border and spawn protection, entity obstruction, actor propagation, and the actual block edit. Automation identity and loader-native claim/logging hooks are delegated to EditAuthority.

    • placeChecked

      public static boolean placeChecked(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player placer, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState state, net.minecraft.core.Direction placedAgainst, net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape finalCollision)
      Places state at pos. Loader checks that can run as queries happen before the world changes; loader placement transactions defer publication until protection accepts the edit, restoring captured state and block-entity data on denial. finalCollision is the completed placement's collision shape, since a block-entity stack can start empty and acquire its real shape only with its first deposit.
